preconditions.description: The number of elements n is an integer between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(a, list) and len(a) == n and all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= n for x in a)
preconditions.description: The array a contains exactly n integers, each between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(d, list) and len(d) == n and all(isinstance(x, int) and (x == -1 or x >= 0) for x in d)
postconditions.description: The output d is a list of n integers, where each element is either -1 or a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all((d[i] == -1 and not any((a[i] % 2) != (a[j] % 2) and reachable(i, j, a, n) for j in range(n))) or (d[i] >= 0 and d[i] == min((moves(i, j, a, n) for j in range(n) if (a[i] % 2) != (a[j] % 2) and reachable(i, j, a, n)), default=float('inf'))) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each position i, d[i] is the minimum number of moves to reach any position j with opposite parity to a[i], or -1 if no such position is reachable.
